title: Migrate to Mojo v1.0.0b1
body:
## Summary
- Replace all `fn` declarations with `def` (not present — code was already using `def`)
- Update `UnsafePointer` nullable usage: `_arr_ptr` and `_obj_ptr` fields changed from raw `UnsafePointer[T, MutAnyOrigin]` to `Optional[UnsafePointer[T, MutAnyOrigin]]`; all dereferences updated to go through `.unsafe_value()`; default-null construction changed from `UnsafePointer[T]()` to `Optional[UnsafePointer[T]](None)`
- Rename `__moveinit__` → `__init__(out self, *, take: Self)` in both `JsonObject` and `JsonValue`
- Rename `__copyinit__` → `__init__(out self, *, copy: Self)` in both `JsonObject` and `JsonValue`
- Bump `mojoproject.toml` and `pixi.toml` to `mojo = ">=1.0.0b1"`

## Test plan
- [ ] `pixi run test-json` passes on Linux
- [ ] `pixi run test-json` passes on macOS
